## About
Rader Collision Center started with Dan Rader's love for working on racecars and hot rods. It was a hobby at first. Dan worked on cars out of his garage, and over time he made a full-time career out of it.
We know accidents happen, so we try to make the repair process as easy as we can. We use computerized equipment, certified technicians and factory-compatible paints, and we back our work with a written lifetime warranty.
We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles for folks across Columbus and central Ohio. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 144 Google reviews.

## Services
- Computerized frame and unibody repairs: We use computerized equipment to get your frame and unibody back where they belong.
- Computerized painting and color matching: Paint matched to your car so the repair blends in.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents worked out without repainting when the damage allows it.
- Mechanical and suspension repairs with alignment: We handle the mechanical and suspension side of a collision too, finished with an alignment.
- Wheel refinishing and repair: Curbed or damaged wheels repaired and refinished.
- Free in shop estimates: Bring your car by and we'll look it over and write up an estimate. (Free)
- Free towing for first 10 miles: If your car can't be driven, we'll tow it in at no charge for the first 10 miles. (Free)
- 4 Stage Lease Return Program: Have a leased car due back at the dealership soon? Bring it to us first and let us do the repairs before the dealer charges you.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and we work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: What if my car needs repairs right before a vacation?
A: No problem. We will drop you off at the airport and in most cases have your car ready for you when you get back.

Q: Do you offer rentals while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes, car rentals are one of the services we offer. Ask us about it when you schedule.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Saturdays are by appointment. Give us a call to set one up.

You can guess, I missed the road and wound up falling into a gravel ditch, hitting my front bumper on one of the tracks and killing one of the fog lights in the process. Me and my father were looking for auto body shops that worked with our insurance when we found Rader Collision Center. The day after the accident we took the car in for an estimate. The receptionist (I believe her name is Marty) was very welcoming and an absolute pleasure to work with while we awaited an estimate. The owner (Dan) was unavailable for estimates at the time (he was doing another one) so she offered to photograph the vehicle's damage so the technicians could determine the estimate. Once Dan became available he offered to zip tie my bumper on while we waited for the estimate to be finalized and repairs to begin. Three weeks later we took the car in.
